text: She looks back down the street to see yet more hostiles approaching.

speaker: Operator Shredder
content: It's almost time.

raw: [name="Operator Shredder"]The enemy's gathering over there. We can't stay much longer.
speaker: Operator Shredder
content: The enemy's gathering over there. We can't stay much longer.

raw: [name="Janie"]Let's give her a bit more time, Shredder. You know Outcast's always punctual.
speaker: Janie
content: Let's give her a bit more time, Shredder. You know Outcast's always punctual.

speaker: Operator Shredder
content: Right.

raw: [name="Janie"]Look! Over there! That's two individuals, incoming!
speaker: Janie
content: Look! Over there! That's two individuals, incoming!

speaker: Janie
content: Outcast, we're over here!

raw: [name="Janie"]Out—No, it's not her. Who's that running this way...?
speaker: Janie
content: Out—No, it's not her. Who's that running this way...?

speaker: Janie
content: Bagpipe?!

raw: [name="Bagpipe"]Huh? So you're the cool Sankta lass's friend?
speaker: Bagpipe
content: Huh? So you're the cool Sankta lass's friend?

raw: [name="Bagpipe"]That's perfect, then. Come, this girl's your pal too, right? She's heavily injured. The Sankta lass told me to bring her to you—
speaker: Bagpipe
content: That's perfect, then. Come, this girl's your pal too, right? She's heavily injured. The Sankta lass told me to bring her to you—

speaker: Janie
content: Outcast...

raw: [name="Janie"]Where is she?! Did something happen to her?
speaker: Janie
content: Where is she?! Did something happen to her?

raw: [name="Bagpipe"]She seemed like she was doin' alright when we parted ways...
speaker: Bagpipe
content: She seemed like she was doin' alright when we parted ways...

raw: [name="Bagpipe"]Not sure why, but she told me to apologize to you for her. Said she can't keep her promise, and that you'd know what to do from here.
speaker: Bagpipe
content: Not sure why, but she told me to apologize to you for her. Said she can't keep her promise, and that you'd know what to do from here.

speaker: Janie
content: Then that must mean...

raw: [name="Janie"]She said it herself. We have to be sure we're safe before we help anyone else!
speaker: Janie
content: She said it herself. We have to be sure we're safe before we help anyone else!

raw: [name="Janie"]Because that's how we save... even more...
speaker: Janie
content: Because that's how we save... even more...

speaker: Janie
content: No—!

speaker: Operator Shredder
content: Jane! Don't go after her!

raw: [name="Operator Shredder"]The Lass said it. We know what to do from here.
speaker: Operator Shredder
content: The Lass said it. We know what to do from here.

speaker: Bagpipe
content: Aye, I agree with him.

raw: [name="Bagpipe"]Do you trust her? I only met her the once, but I trust in her.
speaker: Bagpipe
content: Do you trust her? I only met her the once, but I trust in her.

raw: [name="Bagpipe"]I reckon I knocked out some two dozen on my way here with this girl. Not sure if any of them are chasin' after us.
speaker: Bagpipe
content: I reckon I knocked out some two dozen on my way here with this girl. Not sure if any of them are chasin' after us.

raw: [name="Bagpipe"]The soldiers themselves aren't much of an issue, but if we run into their Caster leader... There's no tellin' how powerful she actually is.
speaker: Bagpipe
content: The soldiers themselves aren't much of an issue, but if we run into their Caster leader... There's no tellin' how powerful she actually is.

raw: [name="Bagpipe"]So, take your friend, and get out of here.
speaker: Bagpipe
content: So, take your friend, and get out of here.

speaker: Operator Shredder
content: What's that flash?!

speaker: Bagpipe
content: An explosion?

raw: [name="Bagpipe"]No, can't be. There's not a bomb out there with a flash this bright. Leastwise, not one we'd live through!
speaker: Bagpipe
content: No, can't be. There's not a bomb out there with a flash this bright. Leastwise, not one we'd live through!

speaker: Bagpipe
content: So it's Arts?!

raw: [name="Bagpipe"]But usin' Arts to your extreme in such a short period of time, the Caster herself would...
speaker: Bagpipe
content: But usin' Arts to your extreme in such a short period of time, the Caster herself would...

raw: [name="Janie"]The blaze... the light... it blew through the clouds...
speaker: Janie
content: The blaze... the light... it blew through the clouds...

speaker: Janie
content: Did... the rain stop?

raw: [name="Bagpipe"]That fire's from the west... Is it the alley from just now?
speaker: Bagpipe
content: That fire's from the west... Is it the alley from just now?

raw: [name="Bagpipe"]If it wasn't for the direction, I would've thought it was bright out already...
speaker: Bagpipe
content: If it wasn't for the direction, I would've thought it was bright out already...

speaker: Janie
content: ...Right...

speaker: Janie
content: The sky's... all bright.

raw: None of them says another word.
content: None of them says another word.

raw: The flames, kindling the skies, are still burning bright—
content: The flames, kindling the skies, are still burning bright—

raw: A raging fury that portends the impending end of the darkness above, or perhaps a shining beacon that impresses the brilliance of life on those aiding each other below.
content: A raging fury that portends the impending end of the darkness above, or perhaps a shining beacon that impresses the brilliance of life on those aiding each other below.

raw: [name="Bagpipe"]That's the most stunnin' daybreak I've seen...
speaker: Bagpipe
content: That's the most stunnin' daybreak I've seen...

raw: [name="Bagpipe"]No wonder she said it'd draw a crowd, haha...
speaker: Bagpipe
content: No wonder she said it'd draw a crowd, haha...

speaker: Bagpipe
content: *Sigh*...

speaker: Operator Shredder
content: Jane...

speaker: Janie
content: Huff... puff... I'm okay.

speaker: Janie
content: Shredder, is it time?

speaker: Operator Shredder
content: It is...

raw: [name="Janie"]Let Uncle Oliver know... we got her.
speaker: Janie
content: Let Uncle Oliver know... we got her.

speaker: Janie
content: —Someone seriously infected.
